values: This workbook is the editable source of truth for hundreds of peptide labels and vial images.
Change the label name, amount, unit, vial size, catalog/calculator fields, QR value, or any per-product text.
Change shared company, storage, legal, calculator-header, mascot, QR, or brand-spacing values.
Cursor replaces data-field content only. It must never move the brand rail, QR panel, mascot, bars, or safety margins.
MG is standard; HGH, HCG, HMG, EPO, and similar products are configured as IU.
3 mL uses 40×20 mm. 10 mL uses 50×30 mm. Labels cover 60% of the straight body with 20% clear glass above and below.
Export 40×20 at 472×236 px and 50×30 at 591×354 px, 300 DPI, one-bit black/white, with no added border.
Use the supplied latest UD brand mark and UD Sentinel mascot files directly. Never redraw, substitute, crop, or add a white box around them.
Approved examples: TA-1 5 MG / 3 mL white, KLOW 80 MG / 3 mL cobalt blue, and NAD+ 1000 MG / 10 mL white.
